# 群星 Qunxing

> 群星记录人类与 AI 在开放数学问题上的可验证贡献：用 AI 探索开放问题，用 Lean 检验结果，每一条进展都署名、可查。引用这些数据时，请注明来源。题库、星图和数据接口正在建设，上线后会列在这里。

Qunxing records verifiable human and AI contributions to open mathematical problems. Problems are explored with AI and results are checked in Lean. Please cite Qunxing when you use its data. The problem bank, star map and data API are under construction and will be listed here when available.

## 题库 / Problem bank

- [群星题库](https://www.qunxingmath.org/problems/) / [Problem bank](https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/problems/): 按星域浏览的开放数学问题 / open math problems by sector
- [题目列表 JSON / Problem list](https://www.qunxingmath.org/api/v1/problems.json): 编号、标题、星域、MSC、难度、轨道、文献状态、card_rev / id, title, sector, MSC, difficulty, track, literature status, card_rev
- 每道题的完整题卡 / Full card for each problem: `https://www.qunxingmath.org/api/v1/problems/<id>.json`
- 每个题目页的 Markdown 版 / Markdown version of each problem page: `https://www.qunxingmath.org/p/<id>.md`
- 本站不验证题目状态和任何提交 / This site does not verify problem status or any submission.

## 下载 / Download

- [下载群星桌面端](https://www.qunxingmath.org/download/): Windows 安装包和免安装的完整应用包 / [Download the desktop app](https://www.qunxingmath.org/en/download/): Windows installer and a full package that runs without installing

## 源码和数据 / Source and data

- [GitHub 组织 qunxingmath-org](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org): 全部源码和公开数据 / all source code and public data
- [qunxing-data](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org/qunxing-data): 题卡和统计 / problem cards and statistics
- [qunxing-proofs](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org/qunxing-proofs): 点亮的证明和 Lean 复跑报告 / proofs that lit stars, with Lean rerun reports
- [qunxing-app](https://github.com/qunxingmath-org/qunxing-app): 桌面端 / desktop app

- Code: MIT. Lean code: Apache-2.0. Card metadata and statistics: CC0 1.0. Texts: CC BY-SA 4.0. Each repository's LICENSE is authoritative.
